pages.title: The Chest Did Not Explode
pages.text: Finish the fight in time to preserve its actual treasure.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The captain may explode and lose the ordinary reward. A no-hit fight is unnecessary: earn the real victory and use its native dropped chest.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Victory before the explosion preserves the ordinary chest; placing it releases loot.
